ordered_estimation: Identify pre-snap safety candidates and list shell-compatible coverage families.
Compare the same safety candidates after the snap; preserve missing-track uncertainty and update the family list.
Compare pre/post corners: receiver following supports man; area responsibility and exchanges support zone. Displacement alone is weak evidence.
Use linebacker drops and receiver/back assignments as supporting evidence when visible; retain unknown for unmeasured responsibilities.
training_status: Reference context and unverified candidate labels only; no model fine-tuning performed.
assignment_policy: Do not promote man from corner distance alone. Require receiver relationships for visible coverage defenders, excluding rushers and deep help; unassigned underneath spacing supports zone but robber/match remain alternatives.
